records.question: On the night of the dance, 400 students show up to the party. 70% of the students who showed up were invited. If 40% of those invited to the party had their invitation revoked and were not allowed into the party, how many invited students attended the party?
records.response:
70% of 400 students were invited, so 400 * 0.7 = 280 students were invited.
40% of the invited students had their invitations revoked, so 280 * 0.4 = 112 students did not attend.
Therefore, 280 - 112 = 168 invited students attended the party.
#### 168

records.question: Macy has a goal of running a total of 24 miles per week. If she runs 3 miles per day, how many miles does Macy have left to run after 6 days so that she could meet her goal?
records.response:
Macy runs 3 miles per day for 6 days, so she runs 3 * 6 = 18 miles in total.
Macy has a goal of running 24 miles per week, so she has 24 - 18 = 6 miles left to run.
#### 6
